# `morphir extension bundle`

- **Usage:** `morphir extension bundle <FLAGS>`

Bundle an already-built host-native MEP process extension

## Flags
- **`--executable <FILE>`** — Already-built native executable; the command runs its describe probe
- **`--extension-id <EXTENSION_ID>`** — Expected extension identity, independent of the source language
- **`--short-id <SHORT_ID>`** — Portable identifier used by the extension release inventory
- **`--version <VERSION>`** — Exact extension SemVer; must match the executable's description
- **`--platform <TRIPLE>`** — Native target triple; must match the CLI build target for this probe
- **`--output <DIR>`** — New bundle directory; its parent must exist and existing paths are refused
